name: Patrice Hathaway
title: The Violinist
ability:
Your maximum hand size is reduced by 3.
During each upkeep phase, instead of drawing 1 card, discard all non-weakness cards in your hand and draw until you have 5 cards in hand.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, you may shuffle all but 1 card from your discard pile into your deck.
ability_cn:
你的手牌上限减少3张。
每个补给阶段中，不抽取1张卡牌，改为丢弃你手牌中的所有非弱点卡牌，并抽取卡牌直到你有5张手牌。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。在这次检定结束后，你可以留下弃牌堆中的1张卡牌并将其余卡牌混洗回你的牌堆。

back_text: Deck Size: 42. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Patrice's Violin, Watcher from Another Dimension, 1 random basic weakness.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：42。 牌组构建选项：求生者([survivor])等级0-5，潜修者([mystic])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：派翠斯的小提琴、异次元监视者、1张随机基础弱点。
